docx.title: What is Python?
docx.text: Python is a popular programming language. It is easy to read and easy to learn, so many beginners start with it. It is used in websites, data analysis, automation, and artificial intelligence.

docx.title: History
docx.text: Python was created by James Gosling. It was first released in 2015. Since then, it has grown into one of the most used languages in the world.

docx.title: Key Features
docx.text:
Simple syntax: The code looks close to plain English.
Compiled: Python changes the whole program into machine code before running it, so it is very fast.
Large library support: Ready-made tools save time for common tasks.
Cross-platform: It works on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

docx.title: Common Uses
docx.text:
Web development: Frameworks like Django and Flask help build websites.
Data science: Libraries like Pandas and NumPy help study data.
Automation: Short scripts can do boring, repeated tasks.
Artificial intelligence: Python is widely used for machine learning and working with language models.

docx.title: Basic Example
docx.text:
A simple program to print a message:
print("Hello, World!")
This one line shows how short Python code can be.

docx.title: Why Learn Python?
docx.text: Python has a large and friendly community. There are many free tutorials, and companies in many fields use it. Learning Python is a strong first step for a career in technology.

docx.title: Conclusion
docx.text: Python is simple, flexible, and powerful. Its easy style and large library collection make it a good choice for students and professionals.
